scripts.prebuild: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; if (existsSync('dist')) for (const entry of readdirSync('dist')) rmSync('dist/' + entry, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.pretest: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; if (existsSync('.test-build')) for (const entry of readdirSync('.test-build')) rmSync('.test-build/' + entry, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.migration:run: npm run build && typeorm migration:run -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
